thag3.16:1.1: Pāpamitte vivajjetvā bhajeyy' uttamapuggale ovāde c' assa tiṭṭheyya patthento acalaṃ sukhaṃ.
thag3.16:4.0: thero. Uddānaṃ: Aṅgaṇiko Bhāradvājo Paccayo Bākulo isi Dhaniyo Mātaṅgaputto Sobhito Vāraṇo isi
thag3.16:5.1: Passiko ca Yasojo ca Sāṭimattiy' Upāli ca | Uttarapālo Abhibhūto Gotamo Hārito pi ca
thag3.16:6.1: thero Tikanipātamhi nibbāne Vimalo kato; aṭṭhatālīsa gāthāyo, therā soḷasa kittitā 'ti.
